sharedSource.sourceFinding: The pinned Hungarian Wikipedia revision identifies the Tatabánya–Oroszlány railway as MÁV line 12 and explicitly lists Környe and Oroszlány in both its route diagram and its stations section. The article cites the 1997 ALFADAT Komárom-Esztergom county handbook and independent railway-history material; no VPE/HÜSZ/KTI/GYSEV source lineage was found during the detailed line-level review.
sharedSource.caveat: The route diagram and stations section are explicit; the individual station rows do not each carry a separate inline citation. This limitation is disclosed for the human reviewer and is not an automatic blocker under the current approved review policy.
